answer: A grove of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dawn of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The raven of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
